caseNameFull: Marion A. Morse, in Error v. Sidney A. Brown, Sheriff of New London County, Conn.
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of Errors of the State of Connecticut.
attorneys: Mr. Donald G. Perkins and Mr. Chas. W. Comstock for the plaintiff in error., Mr. Chas. B. Whittlesey for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.
